meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 收到安全审查请求时,Claude 进入团队模式:3 名漏洞猎人并行找问题,2 名 PoC 工程师安全复现验证,最终输出 PASS、PASS WITH FINDINGS、BLOCK 结论和含严重度分级的修复建议报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“security-research”“security review”等触发词,或键入 /security-research,或要求做安全审查、威胁模型验证时触发。

say.text: 用 security-research 审查当前代码仓库有没有可利用的漏洞。
用 security-research 审计这次 PR 相对基线的改动。
say.note: 未指定目标时会自动对比当前分支与上游差异。

say.text: 做个发布前安全检查,让 PoC 工程师验证漏洞能否复现。
say.note: 没有可行攻击路径的发现会被降级或剔除。

howto.what_en: When a security review is requested, Claude enters Team Mode: 3 hunters scan in parallel while 2 PoC engineers safely verify findings, then produces a PASS/PASS WITH FINDINGS/BLOCK verdict and severity-ranked fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by terms such as 'security-research', 'security review', or the /security-research command, or when a security review or threat-model validation is requested.

say_en.text: Use security-research to audit this repository for exploitable issues.
say_en.note: Returns a verdict and severity-ranked findings.

say_en.text: Use security-research to audit this PR's diff against its base.
say_en.note: No target: it audits the branch vs upstream.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release security check and have a PoC engineer verify exploitability.
say_en.note: Findings without a working path are downgraded or dropped.
